next.reason: 1985 b requires a nonnumeric literal for a numeric edited report item ('literal-1 in the VALUE clause must be a nonnumeric literal'; editing has no effect). 2023 accepts a numeric one: §2023:13.18.63.3 SR6 'literals in formats 1, 2, and 4 of the VALUE clause may be numeric', edited per §2023:13.18.63.3 SR11 (applied to format 4 by §2023:13.18.63.3 SR34), and BLANK WHEN ZERO then affects initialization (only alphanumeric/national literals are exempt, §2023:13.18.63.4 GR8, §2023:13.18.63.3 SR8). Looser. Numeric-category (§2023:13.18.63.3 SR2), alphanumeric-category (§2023:13.18.63.3 SR4), alignment and 'not affected by a JUSTIFIED clause and no editing' for nonnumeric literals (§2023:13.18.63.4 GR7, via §2023:13.18.63.4 GR21) are kept, so every 1985 VALUE means the same; the BWZ difference arises only in the new numeric-literal case.
